totalSupplyFlyWheel.designObjective: Use a controlled portion of PHENIX supply to strengthen the token's own infrastructure, utility, liquidity, community and mission while allowing transparent permanent supply reduction. This is a structural objective and not a promise of token-price appreciation.

supportedLanes.purpose: Support the infrastructure PHENIX is built on, including WorldzLaunchPad, security, hosting, development, automation, maintenance, audits and operational resilience.
Build and fund OneWorldz humanitarian and charitable impact capacity with public accounting and proof of use.
Maintain a disclosed PHENIX/Worldz treasury reserve for approved ecosystem obligations and long-term resilience.
Reward verified community contribution, education, onboarding, testing, moderation, security reporting and ecosystem participation.
Support additional verified builders and team contributors only through disclosed lock and vesting schedules; no unrestricted liquid team release.
Fund integrations, grants, tooling, partnerships and growth work that demonstrably expands PHENIX or Worldz utility.
Add liquidity only under the PHENIX staged-liquidity rules and proof requirements.

hardRules: 47,500,000 PNEX is the maximum lifetime supply assigned to this master reserve; it is not additional supply

the FlyWheel may seek to strengthen utility, liquidity and supply discipline but must not claim guaranteed price appreciation

miracleRunway.purpose: Use approved FlyWheel infrastructure and ecosystem work to harden reusable WorldzLaunchPad systems before launch #004 MIRACLE, without treating PNEX as guaranteed funding for MIRACLE market price or buyers.

Worldz OmniBuildz cross-chain LP and LinkedAsset infrastructure

flyWheelReserve.rule: A cycle allowance only makes that amount eligible for approved FlyWheel actions. It does not automatically transfer PNEX.

perUniversalCycle.rule: Each cycle may burn zero up to 25% of that cycle's newly vested FlyWheel allowance. The burn amount must be separately approved; the remaining allowance stays governed by the FlyWheel.
